title: Lifetime-unified quadratic and cubic approximations of fluorescence peak time for a time-domain diffuse-light response
summary: We study the temporal maximum of a boundary response generated by a coupled diffusion system in a half-space with Robin boundary conditions and a point fluorophore. The fluorescence lifetime enters through a one-sided exponential time convolution. Previous peak-time approximations were derived under separate short- and long-lifetime scalings. We construct a single reduced peak-time formula for every positive ratio of lifetime to the intrinsic width of the transport peak, thereby describing the transition between these regimes without switching formulas.
